title: Tales of Nomad (miniquest)
start: Sift through Nomad's memory on the western side of the lower level of the Underworld. (Return to the Underworld by passing through Death's door in Death's office.)

recommended.t: 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport, Ring of duelling or teleport runes to Ourania Runecrafting Altar
Wilderness sword for easy teleports to Edgeville
Ring of respawn for easy teleports to Soul Wars lobby
Archaeology journal for teleport to east Varrock

rewards.t: Three experience lamps of 1,500 experience each.

steps.t: Enter the River of Noumenon by passing through the door behind Death in Death's office. [Chat: 1 River Noumenon.]
Approach the Sinister figure on the west side at the bottom of the stairs, then sift through Nomad's memory.
In each of the following locations, in order, "Sift through", "End" and then "Witness" the memory and receive the text saying where the next memory is.
Once there is text overlaid on your screen, you can click away and move on to the next memory
Return to the start point of the miniquest, and talk to the Sinister figure.
